design_token_violations.issue: DSColors.violet = Color(red:0.56,green:0.35,blue:0.95) ≈ #8F59F2 is a non-spec purple that conflicts with the spec's single violet token (#00D4FF = DSColors.Spec.violet); this non-spec color propagates as the UI accent to LeftRail.swift:55,63,67, BottomTimeline.swift:22,25, RightInspector.swift:29,171,219, FounderHomeView.swift:29,117,120,125, OmegaView.swift:23,26,43 — spec defines only one violet token
hardcoded NSColor(red:0.05,green:0.05,blue:0.07) ≈ #0D0D12 should be derived from the bg token (DSColors.bg / DesignTokenSIMD.bg = #0A0E27); value is incorrect and not referenced by token name
hardcoded DSColors.accentAmber used for Build Space hammer icon; should be DSColors.Spec.build (#4A6FA5 = build token) per spec 'Build Space label/area (build token)'

notes: The app is substantially on-spec: all nine design tokens are correctly defined with exact hex values, the 3-pane shell (LeftRail 200pt / center canvas / RightInspector 320pt) plus TopBar and BottomTimeline 120pt are all present, the Metal organism map correctly renders all five chambers (Forge, Institute, Board, Omega, Registry), the constitutional boundary correctly encloses Kernel and YubiKey while placing Build Space outside it, the privacy membrane and autopoietic flow lines are implemented, the VoicePill uses the spec violet token (#00D4FF), the Right Panel has all required elements (chamber scores with correct fallbacks, 10/10 proofs + Shalom, 5 Ring 5 gates all red, Alexandria counts), and no placeholder strings appear. Three gaps were found: (1) medium — BuildSpaceView's mode-panel icon uses DSColors.accentAmber instead of the spec build token; (2) low — NSInfinityCommands Habitat menu items have empty action closures, making menu-click routing non-functional (keyboard shortcuts still work via KeyboardHandler); (3) low — WindowManager.configureMainWindow is dead code containing a hardcoded wrong-hex background color (~#0D0D12 vs bg token #0A0E27). Three design-token violations are flagged: the introduction of a non-spec DSColors.violet (~#8F59F2 purple) that shadows the spec's canonical violet (#00D4FF) throughout the UI chrome is the highest-priority concern; the other two mirror the third gap and the BuildSpaceView icon issue.
